name: Rate Type And Lookback 2
definition: Specifies the pricing expressed as a rate type or a rate name complemented with lookback and crystallization days.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the rate type as an index type or by its name.

LookBackDays.name: Look Back Days
LookBackDays.definition: Number of days prior to the current day to source the rate.

CrystallisationDate.name: Crystallisation Date
CrystallisationDate.definition: Identifies the penultimate accrual date of the transaction to the final (repurchase) date. Crystallising the penultimate fixing into a fixed rate for the final business day. This will allow for parties to send timely settlement instructions for the repurchase leg of the transaction. Default value is 1 day.

Tenor.name: Tenor
Tenor.definition: Specifies the tenor of the interest rate index (when the interest rate is calculated).
